text.title: RequestGuid
text.description: RequestGuid of the measuring point request

variables.name: FlowRunHistoryLink
variables.value: Link to Run History

parameters.item/Detail: The counter is no longer missing

parameters.specification/query: EVALUATE SELECTCOLUMNS(FILTER('Functional Locations', 'Functional Locations'[Functional Location] IN {@{join(body('Select_FL_quoted'), ',')}}), "FL", 'Functional Locations'[Functional Location], "Description", 'Functional Locations'[Functional Location Description], "PlantKey", 'Functional Locations'[Plant Key], "SystemNo", 'Functional Locations'[Plant Section Key])

value.reason: @if(empty(outputs('FL')), 'No functional location - contact Master Data.', concat('No system found for ', outputs('FL'), ' - contact Master Data.'))

parameters.item/Detail: @concat('No System Manager is configured for system ', items('For_each_unresolved')?['sysNo'])
parameters.item/Comment: @concat('No System Manager is configured for system ', items('For_each_unresolved')?['sysNo'], ' - contact Master Data.')

parameters.WebhookApprovalCreationInput/details:
@concat('**Request:** ', coalesce(outputs('RequestNo'), ''), '

**Requester:** ', coalesce(outputs('RequesterName'), ''), '

**New counters for you to approve:**

', join(body('My_lines'), '

'), '

Approve, or Return with a comment telling the requester what to change.')
parameters.WebhookApprovalCreationInput/itemLinkDes: Open the request in the app

parameters.emailMessage/Subject: @concat('Measuring point request ', coalesce(outputs('RequestNo'), ''), ' returned - correct it and submit again')
parameters.emailMessage/Body:
Measuring point request @{coalesce(outputs('RequestNo'), '')} was returned by the system approval:

@{replace(replace(replace(outputs('Return_comment'), '&', '&'), '<', '<'), '>', '>')}

Correct the rows in the app and submit the request again.

parameters.emailMessage/Subject: @concat('Measuring point request ', coalesce(outputs('RequestNo'), ''), ' - create counter(s) in PRODOS/SRO')
parameters.emailMessage/Body:
Measuring point request @{coalesce(outputs('RequestNo'), '')} has new counters that do not exist in PRODOS/SRO yet. Please create them:

    @{join(body('My_counter_lines'), '')}

When a counter is created, open the request, select Details on the row and select Mark counter created. The request goes to Master Data when all counters are created.

Open the request in the app

The new counters in measuring point request @{coalesce(outputs('RequestNo'), '')} have been approved by the system managers.

@{if(greater(length(body('Open_counters')), 0), 'Counters that are missing in PRODOS/SRO are created first. The request goes to Master Data when they are marked as created.', 'The request is now with Master Data for creation in SAP.')}

parameters.emailMessage/Subject: An error occured in the flow - @{workflow()?['tags']?['flowDisplayName']}
parameters.emailMessage/Body:
Hi,

An error was detected in the following flow instance (a measuring point request).

>Timestamp
@{body('Convert_UTC_time_to_DK_time_zone')}

>Run History
@{variables('FlowRunHistoryLink')}

Thank you
